title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Bank Heist
description: Attackers compromised a third-party service provider and used the bank's own account to transfer approximately €100 million (estimates up to €118M / $133M), later converted to cryptocurrency. Customer funds and accounts were not affected. Contained after temporary transfer suspensions.
impact: Significant financial loss to the bank; investigation ongoing by French authorities.

title: JPMorgan, Visa, Mastercard Vendor Data Exposure
description: n0n ransomware group claimed an attack on Qubole (third-party data analytics vendor). Customer data including names and emails for JPMorgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard cardholders was leaked. No direct account drains reported.
impact: Data exposure for phishing; financial institutions confirmed vendor-related incidents.
